0.9.134.title: Compass 0.9.134
0.9.134.intro: Compass 0.9.134 is now on the stable channel, with the fixes and improvements tested in recent betas.

sections.heading: Improvements
items: Skip intro now uses TheIntroDB's new API for more reliable intro and recap detection.
Profile badges show readable names, for example "theme creator" instead of "theme_creator".
Loading screens show the Compass mark instead of the old boat.

sections.heading: Fixes
items: The sidebar brand lines up correctly in right-to-left languages.
Updates are signed with a new key and delivered from Compass's own servers.
